before.name: Jennifer Moriarty
before.description: Jennifer Moriarty is an Evanston attorney detained by federal immigration agents on October 31, 2025 after approaching with her phone to record their treatment of a motorist following a collision. She described being tackled, handcuffed and driven around in an SUV. She told the Chicago Tribune that she was allowed to leave more than five hours later at an FBI field office. A federal court opinion independently records her detention and release without charges.

credit: Arthur Maiorella / For the Chicago Sun-Times, April 27, 2026.
